decisions: Local desktop application: Python 3.11+, PySide6, Pillow, Shapely, psutil; deliver a PyInstaller directory bundle without external Python.
JPG + Foundry scene JSON input; separate cropped native-resolution RGBA PNG per disconnected closed region, with a mandatory 3-pixel guard beyond signed user offset.
Export placement.json records source and transformed scene coordinates; it is a DALE manifest, not a native Foundry scene import.
Use wall contours, local repairs, and manual brushes; no semantic terrain recognition.
Original JPG/JSON stay unchanged. Temporary closures, point edits, automatic joins, and brushes remain editor operations.
Target 16384 pixels per input side; warn above 8192; use reduced previews, memory preflight, and striped cancellable exports.
Foundry 13/14 explicit targets; 5-ft elevation presets with custom whole feet. Actual Foundry placement remains separately configured.
Right-drag pans in every tool, including fit zoom.
Gap tolerance in source pixels supports endpoint pairs and T junctions; default 0 disables joining. Signed offset expands/contracts contours.
Applied masks remain immutable snapshots. Geometry/settings changes affect preview and the next mask.
Edit points uses fixed 10-screen-pixel circular handles, pointing-hand hover, insertion spacing of one diameter, shared-node movement, and undoable junction deletion.
Self-contained ZIP .dale projects preserve exact sources, operations and redo, placement, geometry, viewport, language/tool state, and unfinished closures.
After every project update, rebuild the complete ignored DALE/ portable folder and preserve UserData/user files; record source hashes in build-info.json.
English technical documentation/serialization and Russian chat; English/Russian UI with translated tooltips, persistent language selection, Russian initial default.
Open pair automatically selects the sibling same-stem .json; show a JSON picker only when it is absent. Invalid matching JSON uses the existing import error flow.

Latest color instruction: closed geometry cyan, open lines pure RGB (255, 0, 0) red; 3-screen-pixel cosmetic strokes with a black backing and 1-pixel color center. Supersedes prior thickness and diagnostic colors.

Two text-only top rows: unframed general commands, then geometry/pixel set selection plus Hand/Fit/Walls. Left square icon tools followed by double-height diameter and Snapping (px) tiles with centered inputs and visible minus/plus buttons; Russian term is Прилипание (px).
New line uses press/drag/release; snapping radius 0-256 screen pixels, default 14, prioritizes vertices and excludes self-edges on movement.

Circular geometry erasers remove touched edges or vertices across swept drags, commit one undo step, and support Escape cancellation. Geometry diameter uses screen pixels; raster diameter uses source pixels.
Ctrl+wheel changes active tool size globally; over size/distance controls it adjusts that control. Alt-click adds free closure corners.

Single-row footer shows map dimensions, current closed/open component counts, crop dimensions including 3-pixel guards, region selection, and language. Minimum window is 1024 x 768; open counts remain connected unresolved groups.
Optional project UI fields retain snapping, geometry size, mode, and export selection; older schema-1 archives load with defaults.
Localized hover help covers every application control, including embedded numeric editors, selectors, scrollbars, overflow controls, and menus; keep action names in icon-only tooltips.
Persist selected Foundry major (13/14) and language together in portable UserData/settings.json using merged atomic writes. Project loading restores and remembers its target version.

Use the fixed English window title Dungeon Alchemist Levels Export with padded major/minor/revision display. Every Windows build invocation advances only revision automatically; major/minor require explicit owner instruction.

validated.result: RGBA, dimensions, contour alpha, brush alpha, and elevation metadata verified.
Legacy-style scene schema, zero shifts/padding, matching canvases, identical day/night wall arrays, and incomplete/open contours verified. Representative daytime overlays visually inspected.

validated.scope: Existing geometry/export/archive/Qt coverage, merged Foundry/language preferences, revision-only build increments without major/minor rollover, and version mismatch rejection before writes.

validated.result: English/Russian geometry and pixel screenshots inspected: two text-only top rows, square icon-only left tools in one column, dark-gray palette, cyan/red geometry, circular eraser, region highlight, and complete footer.
Native-resolution cropped image and placement manifest produced from the existing upper-floor contour; no live Foundry validation.
Self-contained archive written with original real JPG/JSON and editing history.

DALE.exe launched from the OS temporary working directory with PATH limited to Windows/System32, loaded a self-contained synthetic .dale project and its 3 operations, rendered a screenshot, and exited with code 0. No Python command was invoked.
Normal visible Windows DALE.exe window loaded the real upper-floor .dale archive, rendered a screenshot, and exited with code 0 via the smoke timer.

Qt Open pair checks passed for automatic same-stem JSON loading without a second picker, fallback selection when absent, and cancellation preserving the active session. The full existing suite remains 75 passed.

Standalone isolated-PATH launch loaded the synthetic .dale archive and 4 history operations. Native Windows launch opened the real 13500x16200 pair. Both exited 0 through smoke timers; screenshots inspected for styled icons/panels, cyan/red line classification, complete footer and language control.

Audited 65 interactive Qt controls through Russian/English/Russian switching: no empty or wrong-language help. Tool-set switching restores the last used tool within the window; existing 90 tests pass.

Standalone isolated-PATH startup loaded the 4-operation .dale archive. Native startup opened the real 13500x16200 pair, with two text-only top rows, square icon-only left tools, dark-gray theme, complete footer and localized help. Both smoke processes exited 0. Project reload also retained the pixel tool set while Pan was active.

Real Qt button/wheel checks passed for both diameter tiles and snapping. All tools and centered editors remain visible at 1024 x 768. Audited 68 interactive controls in RU/EN/RU. A representative 16200-square map footer fits one row. Restarting windows retained Foundry 13/14 and language independently. English/Russian and minimum-window screenshots inspected. Raster inspection confirmed a black/color/black horizontal stroke with exact RGB values and pure-red center pixels.

Temporary-repository tests verified synchronized revision increments, 999-to-1000 without minor rollover, preservation of unrelated state, and mismatch rejection without writes. Repository checker now enforces version agreement.

completed.result: Inspected all six real input pairs and validated the current zero-padding/zero-shift import profile. Real image PNG export verified; live Foundry placement remains NEXT-002.
Implemented validated portable ZIP .dale save/load, exact sources and undo/redo history, settings and pending closures.
Zero-alpha RGB is compacted without changing visible RGB; default export now uses separate crops with 3-pixel edge guards.
Built the complete Windows x64 portable directory bundle at DALE/DALE.exe; native real-map and isolated-PATH packaged startup checks passed.

pending.task: Validate floor placement on Foundry 13 and 14, confirm exact builds/modules and scene units, then design version-specific scene/tile export adapters if needed.
Evaluate selected-region masking and edge refinement after real sample review.
Design reusable boundaries across aligned floors. Manual free outlines are now possible with New line; do not infer heights from filenames.

limitations: No direct Foundry connection, scene mutation, native scene import export, or multi-floor scene assembly; actual Foundry 13/14 placement unverified.
Only the observed legacy zero-shift/zero-padding profile is validated with real samples; nonzero legacy shifts and other variants need explicit evidence/adapters.
Gap joining cannot recover missing roof geometry. Trace missing outlines manually with New line; automatic boundary reuse and per-face selection inside a connected object remain future work.
The preview omits the mandatory extra 3-pixel export guard; exported PNGs add it around the effective contour.
Unknown low-level import/ZIP/library error details can remain English; application actions, tooltips, guidance, and dialogs are bilingual.
